description: This file defines the RetryMiddleware class used in the GuzzleHttp library, which handles retrying HTTP requests based on specified conditions, employing backoff strategies.

classes.name: RetryMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class that implements request retries with customizable decider functions and delay strategies.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the retry decider, next handler, and optional delay function.

methods.name: exponentialDelay
methods.description: Static method providing a default exponential delay calculation in milliseconds.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware, executing the next handler and attaching fulfillment and rejection handlers for retries.

methods.name: onFulfilled
methods.description: Creates a callback to handle successful responses, deciding whether to retry.

methods.name: onRejected
methods.description: Creates a callback to handle failed responses or errors, deciding whether to retry.

methods.name: doRetry
methods.description: Performs a retry of the request with computed delay.
